_comment: Revoked/burned ceremony signing keys. Keys listed here must NOT be trusted for packs signed after their revocation timestamp. Public keys are kept in this directory ONLY so historical/archived pack signatures (signed before revocation) remain verifiable. Policy: treat any signature from a revoked key created after `revoked_at` as invalid.

revoked_keys.reason: dev private key was committed to this repo by mistake and signed every published pack; the key is burned/compromised (R4-9a rotation)
revoked_keys.public_key_retained_for: historical verification of packs archived before the rotation only
